title: Dark Chocolate Espresso Éclairs
hookLine: Hollow crisp choux shells piped full of vanilla crème pâtissière and dipped in mirror dark glaze.

steps.title: Heat Oil & Prep Cooling Rack
steps.instructionTemplate: Pour neutral frying oil into a heavy pot to 2 inches deep and heat steadily to 350°F (175°C). Set a wire cooling rack over paper towels nearby and measure out {choux_ec} and {pastry_ec} so everything is ready to fry cleanly.

steps.title: Bake Choux Logs 25m Until Crisp
steps.instructionTemplate: Pipe 5-inch logs of {choux_ec} and bake at 400°F (205°C) for 25 mins until deep golden and hollow. Keep {choux_ec} prepped and measured within reach so each step comes together smoothly and evenly.

steps.title: Pipe Cream Inside & Dip in Glaze
steps.instructionTemplate: Poke two holes underneath, pipe full of {pastry_ec}, and dip tops into glossy {glaze_ec}. Gently press the coating onto every side so it adheres evenly, then let excess drip off before transferring to a clean tray.
steps.creatorSecret: Glaze or toss in sugar while still warm so the coating melts lightly and clings to every ridge.

steps.title: Drain Crisp, Toss & Serve Fresh
steps.instructionTemplate: Transfer to the wire rack to drain excess oil for 1–2 minutes while still piping hot, then finish with {glaze_ec}. Serve Dark Chocolate Espresso Éclairs fresh while the exterior is shatteringly crisp.

ugcQuotes.quote: Turned out bakery-grade on my first try! Ready in 45 mins.
